gates.title: Per-image licensing, archive capture, and public availability
findings: Rights holder of the ad content is recorded from the printed notice: "© 1996 Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved."
Internet Archive item has no rights or licenseurl field; the scan is a patron upload in the boardwatchmagazine collection. No licence or permission record exists.
Access was an anonymous public download of one leaf: no account, lending, payment, CAPTCHA, terms acceptance or watermark removal.
Magazine publisher's 1996 legal entity was not established from a primary record.
gates.reason: Devin ruled on 2026-09-15 that every R14 item is kept; six rounds of rights approval preceded this and no further rights review is requested.
gates.decision: Approved: keep the asset. Rights position accepted as documented.
gates.approver: Devin (standing rights ruling, 2026-09-15: all R14 items kept; no further rights review)

claims.claim: The image is a period MSDN advertisement (script: "old MSDN ads").
claims.evidence: Full-page Microsoft ad featuring the Microsoft Developer Network box, the URL http://www.microsoft.com/msdn, and body copy describing the MSDN subscription (source/original.jp2; IA OCR of leaf 96).
claims.note: The ad pairs MSDN with the Visual C++ Subscription; Visual Basic is not shown on this page (see RQ-XTRA-02-2).

claims.evidence: Neighbouring leaves' printed footers read "Boardwatch - June 1996"; ad footer reads "© 1996 Microsoft Corporation"; IA item date 1996-06.

claims.claim: Page context: Boardwatch Magazine, June 1996, printed page 97.
claims.evidence: Leaf 95 footer "96 Boardwatch - June 1996"; leaf 97 footer "98 Boardwatch - June 1996"; this leaf has no folio and shows mirrored show-through of "98" from its reverse (evidence/folio-showthrough.png); scandata pageNumber 97.
claims.correction: An early low-resolution preview was misread as page 96; the show-through folio is mirrored. All records use page 97.

claims.claim: source/original.jp2 is the intended leaf and is unmodified.
claims.evidence: Dimensions 2489x3228 match scandata leaf 96 (leaf 95 is 2423x3222); SHA-256 e0108c4d6daecfc0e68a82b31f62d231ff2c5311290733cfa5a878989fdc3df3 recorded at download and re-checked by src/render_frame.py before and after rendering.

claims.claim: Not a modern Microsoft graphic presented as archival.
claims.evidence: Scan of a 1996 print page with period products (Visual C++ 4.0, MSDN box), period tagline and show-through from the physical magazine.

claims.claim: Ad's own statement: Visual C++ 4.0 was "PC Week Analyst's Choice, November 27, 1995".
claims.reason: Advertiser claim reproduced in the image; the video does not assert it. Not narrated, so not verified.
